name: v247_rd_ad_cap60_no_reversal
hypothesis: The v246 R&D/ad efficiency signal was strong but TOP1000-fragile. Removing the short-return sleeve and tightening the cap gate tests whether the edge survives in larger, more liquid names.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.60, 0.330 * group_rank(ts_rank(fnd6_newa2v1300_xrd / abs(sales), 126), industry) + 0.250 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(ts_delta(fnd6_newa2v1300_xrd / abs(sales), 252)), 126), industry) + 0.220 * group_rank(ts_rank(sales / (abs(fnd6_newa1v1300_emp) + 1), 126), industry) + 0.120 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 90), industry) + 0.080 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 90), industry), -1)
notes: Primary LSUS repair for 1Y7RA2xJ; no analyst/news/option/open-close.

name: v247_rd_ad_subindustry_stability
hypothesis: Subindustry neutralization may reduce sector-specific R&D intensity artifacts and improve sub-universe robustness.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.50, 0.310 * group_rank(ts_rank(fnd6_newa2v1300_xrd / abs(sales), 126), subindustry) + 0.250 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(ts_delta(fnd6_newa2v1300_xrd / abs(sales), 252)), 126), subindustry) + 0.210 * group_rank(ts_rank(sales / (abs(fnd6_newa1v1300_emp) + 1), 126), subindustry) + 0.130 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * unsystematic_risk_last_90_days, 90), industry) + 0.100 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (correlation_last_90_days_spy - correlation_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry), -1)
notes: Tests whether R&D/ad signal is sector-mix driven.

name: v247_rd_stability_pure_largecap
hypothesis: If the employee-productivity leg is what causes small-cap fragility, a pure stable-R&D-intensity variant should have a cleaner robustness profile, though likely lower Sharpe.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.55, 0.440 * group_rank(ts_rank(fnd6_newa2v1300_xrd / abs(sales), 126), industry) + 0.280 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(ts_delta(fnd6_newa2v1300_xrd / abs(sales), 252)), 126), industry) + 0.160 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 90), industry) + 0.120 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 90), industry), -1)
notes: Pure R&D stability ablation; no employee, income, advertising, or reversal sleeve.

name: v247_rd_positive_ad_drag_balance
hypothesis: R&D intensity may be valuable when paired with restrained advertising drag and labor productivity, distinguishing productive innovation spend from promotional expense.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.50, 0.300 * group_rank(ts_rank(fnd6_newa2v1300_xrd / abs(sales), 126), industry) - 0.220 * group_rank(ts_rank(abs(fnd6_xad) / abs(sales), 126), industry) + 0.200 * group_rank(ts_rank(sales / (abs(fnd6_newa1v1300_emp) + 1), 126), industry) + 0.160 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 90), industry) + 0.120 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 90), industry), -1)
notes: Different investment composition mechanism; close if LSUS or Sharpe fails.
